description: Removes one or several identified empty places from the selected wedding and its property order, and returns the order that remains. The places list supplies their ids. With several, each place is removed or kept on its own, and the result lists which were removed and which kept, with the reason. A dry run reports the same without removing anything. This removes any recommendation or booking link on a removed place. Any rooms, including archived history, prevent removal. No rooms or payments are deleted. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

dry_run.description: When true, reports which of the named places would be removed and which kept, with reasons, and removes nothing. Defaults to false.

place_id.description: Identifier of the empty property to remove, from the selected wedding’s places list. Provide this or place_ids.

place_ids.description: Identifiers of several empty properties to remove, from the selected wedding’s places list. Only these are considered. Provide this or place_id.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: remove_my_place
title: Remove Empty Place
